name: LP333 ID3 singleton translation canonicalization
hypothesis: Canonicalizing the nine normalized singleton translations independently in both ID3 sequences will remove an exact factor-81 symmetry and may produce terminal evidence under a 300-second proof-producing run.
evidence_unit: one source-pinned full fixed-multiplier ID3 formula with complete decimation/swap static symmetry and exactly the normalized singleton-translation orbit canonicalization added
claim_boundary: A verified terminal result decides only fixed multiplier family ID3 and its separately normalized coherent translated version. A resource ceiling remains UNKNOWN and does not decide unrestricted LP333 or H668.

baseline.evidence: Source subgroup ID3 has elements {1,10,100}, nine singleton and 108 size-three position orbits, and 116 full PAF representative equations. The static-symmetry generator and solver are hash-bound descendants of commits 4277d0c and 597e49a.
baseline.measurement: ID3 is source-OPEN. Prior campaign evidence concerns prescribed compression profiles, not the unrestricted fixed ID3 family; no direct LP333 model or complete UNSAT proof exists.

intervention.one_change: Over a freshly bound full-PAF ID3 static-symmetry parent, add only the exact blocking clauses that retain the lexicographically least normalized nine-singleton pattern under translations by multiples of 37, independently for A and B.
forbidden_confounds: changed decimation or sequence-swap lex leaders

controls.name: translation-annihilator
controls.purpose: Prove the declared translations preserve the fixed ID3 invariant space.
controls.expected: Direct modular enumeration for H={1,10,100} gives exactly {0,37,74,111,148,185,222,259,296}.

controls.name: normalized-translation-automorphism
controls.purpose: Prove translation followed by origin sign renormalization preserves normalization, H-invariance, row-sum magnitude, and every periodic autocorrelation.
controls.expected: Exact direct checks pass for all nine translations on deterministic random orbit assignments.

controls.name: singleton-orbit-partition
controls.purpose: Prove the blocking clauses select representatives rather than deleting translation orbits.
controls.expected: All 256 normalized nine-bit patterns partition into 30 orbits with size histogram {1:1,3:1,9:28}; the 171 row-feasible patterns partition into exactly 19 size-nine orbits, each with one retained lexicographic minimum.

controls.name: independent-clause-reconstruction
controls.purpose: Bind the exact canonicalization block without importing the generator.
controls.expected: An independent auditor reconstructs and matches exactly 226 eight-literal blocking clauses per sequence, and rejects a one-literal mutation.

controls.name: full-parent-binding
controls.purpose: Hold the unrestricted fixed ID3 predicate and prior static symmetry fixed.
controls.expected: The parent has all 116 PAF PB equations, 117 primary orbit bits per sequence, 143 nonidentity decimation/swap lex leaders, no profile margins or prune lemmas, and matches at the source clause/variable boundary.

controls.name: positive-fixture
controls.purpose: Detect an invalid normalized translation or PAF encoding.
controls.expected: The published LP63 pair remains a directly verified Legendre pair under all tested independent normalized translations.

controls.name: adversarial-proof-control
controls.purpose: Detect a proof checker that accepts false terminal evidence.
controls.expected: Pinned drat-trim rejects an empty proof against the known SAT control before and after every decisive UNSAT replay.

terminal_outcomes.promote: All modular, automorphism, orbit-partition, clause-reconstruction, parent-binding, positive, model, and proof controls pass; and ID3 yields a directly audited SAT model or a complete independently replayed UNSAT proof.
terminal_outcomes.park: The row-feasible singleton patterns do not all lie in size-nine orbits, so the proposed factor-81 significance floor fails without a target run.
terminal_outcomes.unknown: The exact factor-81 formula passes every control but reaches a wall, memory, proof-volume, or verification ceiling without terminal evidence.
terminal_outcomes.audit-failed: Any modular enumeration, automorphism, orbit partition, clause reconstruction, parent binding, semantic comparison, model audit, proof replay, or bogus-proof control fails.

stop_rules: Stop before the target run unless the 171 row-feasible singleton patterns partition into exactly 19 size-nine orbits.
Stop before the target run unless all 452 blocking clauses reconstruct exactly and the full unrestricted ID3 parent boundary matches.
Terminate at 300 solver seconds, 4 GiB observed RSS, or 1 GiB proof bytes.
Do not interpret or replay an incomplete proof.
Do not import prescribed compression profiles or profile-specific lemmas.

next_actions.promote: Archive and independently recheck the terminal ID3 result; if SAT, construct and verify H668 before any submission preparation.
next_actions.park: Archive the failed symmetry significance gate and move to a different fixed family.
next_actions.unknown: Preserve strict UNKNOWN and derive propagation channels from the 19 canonical singleton cases rather than raising this cap.
next_actions.audit-failed: Repair only the smallest failed symmetry or binding gate and regenerate in fresh directories.

authority.data_scope: Local public-prompt artifacts and source-pinned repositories are authorized for the eight-hour autonomous campaign.
authority.external_actions: A fully audited H668 candidate may be prepared for submission; an actual external form action remains gated by exact destination, artifact, account, and contract terms.
